evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY lines are 14-15 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; lines 17-23 create /app with 'git -C /app init', 'touch /app/.gitkeep' and one commit of .gitkeep, so /app holds only .gitkeep and the git history holds no other file. The build context environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes (file listing; no hidden files); solution/ and tests/ are outside the context and never copied. Assets: seed_data.json is 4 lines: '"snippets": []' and a note 'No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history.' - no starter, schema, route list or UI. Instructions: integration.md:3 names only the entry point and 'GET /api/health' (the same route the template integration note prescribes) and integration.md:5 says 'You may choose your routes and frontend tools'; policy.md:3 leaves 'layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording' to the builder. No database schema, API route list, markup, selector or code is given anywhere in the six notes. Rubric leak: a case-insensitive search of instruction.md, the six notes and the seed for judge, rubric, criteri, grader, cw_, sentinel, score, weight, /tests, solution and oracle returned zero matches. A word-sequence comparison of the public notes against every tests judge.toml, prompt.md and app_context.md found no shared run of 8 or more words; against the judge.toml files at 6 words the longest shared runs are 7 and 6 words of ordinary product phrasing ('the preview the console and the library', 'alt click and ctrl cmd click', 'draft that has a syntax error'), i.e. no criterion text is reproduced. task.toml:2 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]' declares collected outputs and injects nothing into the agent image. Broken-app probe: an agent that only copies what the image supplies has nothing to serve (/app has no server.js), so the image gives no credit path; the hosted run on an earlier candidate recorded nop 0, consistent with this, though that is not a measurement of these bytes. Notes: (1) the agent image was not built and inspected for this review, so the /app contents are established from the Dockerfile text and template identity, not from a container listing; (2) network_mode is public in the agent phase, which the delivery profile declares correct and not reportable; (3) the six notes are detailed behavioural requirements, which is the ask, not a finished or partial deliverable.
